what: exact McNemar test (fx.stats.mcnemar_exact: two-sided binomial test on the discordant pairs) of ReScope (default; calibration draw d) against every other row of the main table, for the two registered binary paired outcomes, per calibration draw d = 0, 1, 2

outcomes.D1: D1 flag of the valid heldout_disjoint rows (teacher forcing, B = 1); pairs = rows (csid)
outcomes.Rel: Rel exact of the 100 edits; pairs = edits

b: pairs with the outcome under ReScope and not under the other row
c: pairs with the outcome under the other row and not under ReScope
draws: a row with calibration draws is paired with ReScope at the same draw index; a row without calibration (one run) is compared with ReScope at each of its draws

holm.all_tests: family = every test of the outcome: backbones x rows x calibration draws (the conservative reading; field p_holm_all_tests)
holm.within_draw: family = the tests of the outcome at one calibration draw: backbones x rows (field p_holm_within_draw)
holm.note: R6 asks for Holm 'over backbones and baselines'; the tests are per draw, so both ways of counting the draws are given

status: secondary / descriptive comparisons (R6: H1 to H3 are the only confirmatory ones); the tests add the statistic that PROTOCOL section 4 names
rows_from_e2: COMP-B, REEDIT-B (all reported complaints) and ReScope-W two-block are rows of table (2b); their flags are read from e2_curves/out/rows (same rows, same driver)
